description: Save an action as a droplet: an application that plays the action on files dropped onto it, with Batch's open, save and naming options (File > Automate > Create Droplet)

action.description: Action name, as in the Actions panel (list_action_sets)

compatibility.description: File name compatibility. Default: the current platform only

destination.description: none: leave files open, save_and_close: save over the source, folder: save into destinationFolder. Default none

destinationFolder.description: Absolute folder path, for destination folder

errorLog.description: Absolute path of a text file to log errors to (Log Errors To File). Omit to stop for errors

fileNaming.description: File Naming for destination folder: up to 6 parts joined in order. Default ["document_name", "extension_lower"]

filePath.description: Absolute path of the droplet to create (an .app on macOS, an .exe on Windows)

overrideOpen.description: Override Action "Open" Commands: the action's own Open steps open each source file instead. Default false

overrideSaveAs.description: Override Action "Save As" Commands: the action's Save As steps save into the destination instead of their recorded place. Default false

startingSerial.description: Starting serial number for serial parts. Default 1

suppressOpenDialogs.description: Suppress File Open Options Dialogs (camera raw and similar). Default true

suppressProfileWarnings.description: Suppress Color Profile Warnings. Default true

name: create_droplet
title: Create Droplet
